mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1200K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a tight labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of INDPRO with SPX returns falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding $460B indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly correlated (p > 0.05) with RSAFS growth in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 1.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 240, the combined signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced borrowing and spending.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 20d are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth, as a proxy for labor market health, positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC between PAYEMS growth and SPX returns falls below 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, indicating a strong economy, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 20d in triggered, non-recessionary instances are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) than in non-triggered.
